group.label: General settings
group.comment: Core configuration settings that control the SEO audit functionality.

field.label: Enable SEO audit
field.comment: When enabled, the module will perform scheduled SEO audits based on the configuration. Disabling will pause all automated audit functionality.

field.label: Exclude URL patterns
field.comment: One path or substring per line. Any URL containing a listed pattern will be skipped. Example: /checkout, /customer, /cdn-cgi/, facebook.com.

group.label: Crawl performance
group.comment: Control how aggressively the SEO audit crawls your store. Lower intensity reduces server load at the cost of a longer crawl time.

field.label: Crawl intensity
field.tooltip:
High — intensive crawl: no delay between requests, suitable for dedicated servers with spare capacity.
Medium — default mode: 200 ms delay, recommended for most stores.
Low — soft crawl: 500 ms delay, use on shared hosting or stores with limited resources.
Custom — expert mode: configure all crawl settings manually.
field.comment: Set the crawl intensity. Custom allows per-field configuration below.

group.label: Custom intensity settings
group.comment: Applies only when Crawl intensity is set to Custom.

field.label: Delay between requests (ms)
field.tooltip: Time to wait between consecutive URL requests. Set to 0 for no delay, 500 for half a second.
field.comment: Delay in milliseconds inserted after each crawled URL. Reduces peak PHP-FPM concurrency on busy stores.

field.label: Maximum URLs per cron run
field.tooltip: The crawler also stops after 5 minutes regardless of this limit.
field.comment: Hard cap on the number of URLs crawled in a single cron run. Set to 0 for no limit (time-bound only).

field.label: Crawl schedule
field.comment: Cron expression for how often the crawler runs. Default */30 * * * * runs every 30 minutes. Use 0 2 * * * to run once a day at 2 AM.

field.label: Server load threshold (%)
field.comment: The crawler pauses when CPU load exceeds this value. Default is 80. Lower this value on servers that are sensitive to load spikes.

field.label: Restart job after (days)
field.comment: The audit job is force-restarted after this many days. Use this as a safety net for stores with more URLs than the crawler can process in one day.
